verdict.rationale: Notte supports scheduling serverless 'functions' (deploy scripts as API endpoints and 'schedule anywhere'), which gives some automation-trigger capability, but there is no evidence of a rules engine, webhooks, or event-based triggers (e.g., 'on page change, do X') as opposed to simple time-based scheduling/API invocation. Missing for 10: explicit event-trigger/webhook support, conditional rule definitions, and any UI/API for defining 'if event then action' automations.
